description: This file defines the MigrationInterface interface for Drupal's migrate module, including constants for migration statuses and results, and method signatures for migration operations.

classes.name: MigrationInterface
classes.description: Interface for migration plugins in Drupal, defining constants and method signatures for managing migration processes.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID of the migration plugin.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label for this migration.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Returns an array of required plugin IDs.

methods.name: getSourcePlugin
methods.description: Returns the initialized source plugin.

methods.name: getProcessPlugins
methods.description: Returns process plugins, optionally based on a provided process configuration array.

methods.name: getDestinationPlugin
methods.description: Returns the initialized destination plugin.

methods.name: getIdMap
methods.description: Returns the ID map plugin.

methods.name: allRowsProcessed
methods.description: Checks if all source rows have been processed.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current migration status.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the current migration status.

methods.name: getStatusLabel
methods.description: Retrieves a user-friendly label for the current status.

methods.name: getInterruptionResult
methods.description: Gets the result to return upon migration interruption.

methods.name: clearInterruptionResult
methods.description: Clears the interruption result.

methods.name: interruptMigration
methods.description: Interrupts the migration with a specified result code.

methods.name: getProcess
methods.description: Returns the normalized process plugin configuration.

methods.name: setProcess
methods.description: Overrides the entire process configuration.

methods.name: setProcessOfProperty
methods.description: Sets the process pipeline for a specific property.

methods.name: mergeProcessOfProperty
methods.description: Merges a process pipeline into a specific property.

methods.name: getMigrationDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for this migration.

methods.name: getDestinationConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the destination configuration array.

methods.name: getSourceConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the source configuration array.

methods.name: getDestinationIds
methods.description: Returns destination identifiers.

methods.name: getMigrationTags
methods.description: Returns migration tags.

methods.name: isAuditable
methods.description: Indicates if the migration is auditable.
